unit_vocabulary.meaning: `adj.` 肯定的；确信的；有把握的
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Dad: Sure.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 确定(sure)要去海边(shore)。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `v.` 冲浪, 网上冲浪 `n.` 激浪, 拍岸浪花
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Many young people love to surf the Internet for new ideas.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：surf the Internet 网上冲浪。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 表面 `v.` 浮出水面；显露
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The leaves floated gently on the calm surface of the lake.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：sur (在上面) + face (脸/面) -> 表面。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: How about a surprise party for them?
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: sur (在……之上) + prise (抓) -> 突然被抓住，感到十分惊讶。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: I turned around and was surprised to see a deer.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 词干法: surprise (使惊奇) + ed (形容词后缀, 感到...) -> 感到惊讶的。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Scarf, sweater and coat.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 毛衣(sweater)很甜(sweet)。

unit_vocabulary.syllable_type: 元音字母组合音节 (Vowel Team)
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Sweep the floor.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：s(蛇)+weep(哭泣) -> 蛇在打扫(sweep)卫生时累得哭泣(weep)。

unit_vocabulary.syllable_type: 元音字母组合音节 (Vowel Team)
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Would you like a sweet?
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 谐音记忆法: 斯威特(sweet)，吃起来甜甜的糖果。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: They are great swimmers.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 词缀法: swim (游泳) + 双写m + er (人) -> 游泳的人。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 摆动；秋千；挥动 `v.` 摆动；转动
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The little girl smiled happily as she sat on the swing.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：在秋千（swing）上像小鸟展翅（wing）一样飞舞。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: They're red tables.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 桌子上有四条腿(table)

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 尾；尾巴；尾部；后部；有……尾巴的；燕尾服；(离去事物的)末尾部分；盯梢人
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The dog has a tail.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 特（tai）别（l）长的尾巴。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: My grandfather practices t'aichi in the park every morning.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 拼音拼读记忆：太极（t'aichi）。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `v.` 拿, 吃；乘坐；占用；拍照
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Someone has taken my pen.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 太客(take)气了，把礼物都拿走了。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` (尤指充满惊险的)故事；(精彩但不一定完全真实的)讲述, 叙述
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The old sailor told us an amazing tale about a giant whale.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：fairy tale 意为“童话故事”。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: He showed a great talent for playing the piano at an early age.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：talent show 意为“达人秀；才艺展示”。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: I help you talk and eat.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 谐音记忆法 (脱壳 - 金蝉脱壳后会说话了)

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: They're tall.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 谐音“头”。个子特别高的人，走在人群里往往一眼就能被别人看到“头”。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: He tapped on the pipe to make a sound.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 拟声词：tap, tap, tap，轻敲的声音。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: We listened to the English conversation on the tape recorder.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：用胶带（tape）把破损的书页粘好。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: People will focus on more creative and difficult tasks.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: t + ask -> 老师布置给你的任务。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: I can taste the ice cream.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 特（ta）爱（ste）吃，品尝美味。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: It began to rain heavily, so we took a taxi home.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：take a taxi 坐出租车。

unit_vocabulary.syllable_type: 元音字母组合音节 (Vowel Team)
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Ms Li teaches English.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 老师(teacher)在教(teach)课。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: We stopped at a teahouse.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 人们在茶馆（teahouse）里喝茶聊天。

unit_vocabulary.syllable_type: 元音字母组合音节 (Vowel Team)
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: You are a team.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 谐音记忆法 (踢木 - 一个小队的人在一起踢木头训练)

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: He passed the basketball quickly to his teammate.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：team (队) + mate (伙伴) -> 队友。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Good teamwork helped our class win first prize in the competition.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：team (队伍) + work (工作) -> 团队合作。

unit_vocabulary.syllable_type: 元音字母组合音节 (Vowel Team)
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: In one hall, I saw an artwork with thousands of glass "tears" falling down.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 谐音记忆: 提着 (tear) 一大袋眼泪。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: We'll have better health care technology in our homes.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: techno(技术) + logy(学科) = 科技。
